entry.note: Q1143296 retained reference point and current Jamek Mosque POI35184852806566 agree on the river-confluence mosque. Named Jamek Mosque POI identifies the central three-domed prayer hall at the river confluence. The contiguous main hall,its two attached side wings and low connecting strips are included;three roof parts and two32 m minaret plans refine that same structure. Nearby detached service/ablution buildings,river works,station,shops and courtyard pavement stay host content. No exact Wikidata-tagged footprint was retained;this is a current named-POI/map correspondence and approximate fit. Heading 1.257641544721982 rad follows the minimum-area rectangle of the central hall;positive Z faces the mapped minaret/entry side. Facing,part membership and roof partitions remain approximate visualization judgments.
